archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) - Industrial Dark / Bloomberg Terminal Variant
design_philosophy: Premium executive feel for heavy industry. Trustworthy, precise, robust, authoritative. Dense information architecture avoiding consumer-SaaS aesthetics.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Control Room Grid Protocol: Dense, gap-4 to gap-6. Use col-span logic to pack data tightly.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-none to rounded-sm (2px max) for a sharp, architectural aesthetic.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Optical alignment, left-aligned tabular data, right-aligned numeric data.

surface_strategies.cards: Flat solid background (surface: #18181b), 1px solid border-white/10. No dropshadows. Rely on 1px borders for definition.
surface_strategies.tables: Grid Borders style. Visible skeleton, border-collapse, mono font for numbers. Alternate row bg-white/[0.02].
surface_strategies.headers: Solid elevated background (#09090b) with hard 1px bottom border. No glassmorphism.

component_styling.buttons: Sharp corners. Primary: bg-amber-500 text-black font-semibold hover:bg-amber-400. Secondary: border border-white/20 hover:bg-white/5.
component_styling.kanban_cards: Dense surface cards, 2px solid left border indicating status (e.g., green=won, amber=negotiation).
component_styling.map_pins: Sharp geometric markers, pulsing dot for 'Hot' opportunities (AI Score > 80).
component_styling.kpi_cards: Large mono-font numeric readouts, subtle trend sparklines, highly structured layout.
component_styling.quotation_form: Shadcn input fields with reduced height (h-8), no rounded corners, tight labels.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Micro-interactions: Border color shifts to white/40. No bouncy scaling. Purely functional feedback.
motion_and_interactions.loading: Terminal-style ASCII loaders or rapid linear progress bars.

icons.usage: Stroke-width 1.5. Purely functional, no decorative fluff.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: APCA standards required. High contrast text on dark backgrounds.
accessibility_and_testing.test_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid with kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='submit-quote-btn').

auth_background.description: Aerial view of active construction site. Use with a heavy dark overlay (bg-black/80) for the login screen background.

dashboard_texture.description: Textured grey concrete wall. Use as a very subtle background layer (opacity-5) in empty states or specific modal backgrounds.

map_context_queretaro.description: Queretaro city context. Can be used subtly in the map UI header.

radar_blueprint_bg.description: Blueprint architecture. Overlay with mix-blend-screen and 10% opacity in the Project Radar section.

project_thumbnail_1.description: Aerial tractor view. Use as a thumbnail for detected projects in the Radar grid.

project_thumbnail_2.description: Drone shot of large site. Use as an alternative project thumbnail.

executive_director.description: Executive portrait for the 'Director General' role avatar.

executive_comercial.description: Executive portrait for the 'Comercial' or 'Operaciones' role avatar.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a strict 'Control Room' dense grid layout for the dashboards. Maximize data density.
Use pure HTML+Tailwind for main structural layouts to allow precision, and heavily customize Shadcn components (strip radii, enforce mono fonts for numbers) to match the industrial look.
Quotation Tool: Build a robust form calculating real-time m2 costs. Use IBM Plex Mono for all numeric readouts.
Project Radar: Prominently display the AI scoring (0-100). Use conditional coloring (Red/Amber/Green) for scores.
Interactive Map: Use a dark-themed map (e.g., styled Leaflet or Mapbox Dark) with custom Lucide pins.
DO NOT use Inter or Roboto. Integrate Chivo (Headings), IBM Plex Sans (Body), and IBM Plex Mono (Data).
Enforce data-testid on all interactive elements for testing.
Do not use generic SaaS gradients (no purple/teal). Stick strictly to the Slate/Amber palette.
